operators.name: pool2d_avgmax

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: [N, C, H, W] where H and W are divisible by kernel_h and kernel_w respectively

semantics: Corresponds to reference self.avg_pool2d(x) and self.max_pool2d(x), both with kernel_size=(kernel_h, kernel_w), stride=(kernel_h, kernel_w), padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False.

Average pooling computes mean over each non-overlapping kernel_h x kernel_w window, equivalent to torch.nn.functional.avg_pool2d(x, kernel_size=(kernel_h,kernel_w), stride=(kernel_h,kernel_w), padding=0, ceil_mode=False, count_include_pad=True).

Max pooling computes maximum over each non-overlapping window, equivalent to torch.nn.functional.max_pool2d(x, kernel_size=(kernel_h,kernel_w), stride=(kernel_h,kernel_w), padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False).
Both outputs are returned in the order (avg_result, max_result).
The input x must be contiguous or strided; the implementation should handle arbitrary strides efficiently (e.g., via cuDNN or custom kernels).
Average pooling with kernel_size=(2,2), stride=(2,2), padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False.
Output shape [16,3,1024,1024], dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride [3145728,1048576,1024,1].
Max pooling with kernel_size=(2,2), stride=(2,2), padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False.
Output shape [16,3,1024,1024], dtype float32, device cuda:0, stride [3145728,1048576,1024,1].
Returns a tuple containing the two tensors in order (avg, max).
